text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training was over. When I visited the 
chairwoman's office on an errand, 
Tazuna-san was still working.
choice_data_list: Please don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you for your concern! However—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how hard <chrname> was working just 
naturally inspired me.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please leave the operations of the "Ramen 
Jamboree" to me. I'll make sure it's 
carried out to perfection, without a 
single flaw!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems her sincere attitude earned quite 
a bit of praise!
